value.rationale: A single accessible membrane current sensor and a tunable reset rate form a motivated nonparametric inverse problem. The result completely identifies the recoverable antisymmetric spatial reset profile and the unavoidable symmetric nullspace and precise positivity-constrained probability fiber, including uniqueness iff antisymmetric total variation equals one; it sharply separates finite sampling from accumulating-rate identification, and shows why a zero entropy measurement at one reset rate need not imply reset symmetry. This resolves a physical observability issue rather than merely recomputing the known stationary density.
